elements.title: Product lifecycle stage: Make
elements.content: A circular product lifecycle diagram highlighting the 'MAKE' stage with a green solar panel icon, alongside four other stages: 'DESIGN AND SOURCE', 'PACKAGE AND SHIP', 'USE', and 'RECOVER'.

elements.title: Smarter chemicals
elements.content: All established iMac final assembly supplier sites use safer cleaners and degreasers in their manufacturing processes, as determined by methodologies like the GreenScreen® assessment.

elements.title: Zero Waste to Landfill
elements.content: No established iMac final assembly supplier sites generate any waste sent to landfill.

elements.title: Supplier energy use
elements.content: Over 20 percent of manufacturing electricity is sourced from supplier low-carbon energy projects, supported by Apple's Supplier Clean Energy Program.
